about: What the drones say, in System Latin (see data/system_latin/system_latin_systemized.md), said as beeps, hums and buzzes - see src/formants/chirps.rs - so that no one hears it as speech; 'means' is what it says in English. 'lines' are by what a drone says them about, one of them picked in turn each time: 'alarm' as it hears the alarm, or a droid shot, while it patrols; 'spotted' as it sees the player; 'searching' as it sets off to where it lost them or was sent; 'calm' as it gives up and patrols again; and 'down' as it is brought down. Something with none, or not given, is done in silence.

alarm.means: Alarm received. Searching for the attacker.
